{{Top|leg}}
'''ZeX555-TR349''' was an automated [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] that was assigned to explore the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]] and [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sectors]] as part of [[Project Wayfarer|Project: Wayfarer]]. The probe was destroyed between the Elrood and Cegul sectors while surveying unexplored systems.
